newsitem.title: UK: Grand Met weak on downgrade talk.
newsitem.headline: Grand Met weak on downgrade talk.

text.p: Shares in UK food and drinks group Grand Metropolitan Plc were weak in early trade on Wednesday on profit-taking after a recent strong run amid talk the stock was being downgraded by several UK houses. Grand Met shares were down 5-1/2p or more than one percent at 484p by 0908 GMT, while the broader market was flat.
"The share has had a very strong run recently so a few people are booking profits," said one market maker.
Grand Met stock has risen by around 13 percent since July on hopes for its restructuring programme and dealers said analysts were reassessing the prospects for the share.
Market sources said that NatWest Securities had downgraded the stock to "hold" from "add".
